text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour complaint handling training
- Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play
- Management: Complaint governance and escalation
- Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements

raw_entities.name: Training & Awareness Policy Framework
raw_entities.description: Establishes the bank's mandatory annual training framework to ensure staff competency in complaint handling, governance, and regulatory compliance. Defines specific training durations and content tailored to different operational roles within the organisation.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Annual Complaint Handling Training for All Staff
raw_entities.description: Mandates that all bank employees complete a minimum of one hour of annual training focused specifically on complaint handling procedures and standards to ensure consistent service delivery.

raw_entities.name: Practical Scenario Training for Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Requires customer-facing personnel to complete a minimum of two hours of annual training utilizing practical scenarios and role-play exercises to enhance practical complaint resolution skills.
context: Customer-facing staff: 2-hour practical scenarios + role play

raw_entities.name: Complaint Governance and Escalation Training for Management
raw_entities.description: Mandates that management personnel receive annual training focused on complaint governance frameworks and escalation protocols to ensure effective oversight and regulatory compliance.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Compliance and Reporting Training for Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Requires the compliance function to undergo annual training specifically covering FCA rules and reporting requirements to maintain regulatory adherence and proper oversight.
context: Compliance: FCA rules and reporting requirements
